attributes.name: Anatolian Shepherd Dog
attributes.description: The Anatolian Shepherd Dog is a large breed of flock guardian dog that originated in Turkey. It is a powerful and athletic breed, with a long, coarse coat. Its head is large and round, with small, erect ears. Its legs are strong and muscular, and its tail is usually docked. The Anatolian Shepherd Dog is an intelligent and loyal breed, and it makes an excellent family pet. It is an active breed, and it needs plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. It is loyal and affectionate, and it enjoys spending time with its family.
